items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: there was Rene on trumpet, and Zeb on clarinet

ctx.x: Yeah. I didn't know. We had the Rene band that time, I remember at the Bulls, there was Rene on trumpet, and Zeb on clarinet, and, uh, Chani, what they call, which his name is, Abbie Forrester, on drums.
